summary: HCW Biologics filed an 8-K disclosing a September 23, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with an existing institutional investor for 903,614 units at $1.6599 per unit, each unit comprising one pre-funded warrant (exercise price $0.0001) and the right to one common warrant, for gross proceeds of roughly $1.5 million. Common warrant issuance requires Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) stockholder approval; common warrants strike $1.66, expire 5.5 years from issuance, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. Maxim Group LLC is sole placement agent; proceeds fund working capital and clinical development. Watch stockholder approval timing and warrant overhang.
